trigger: Explore or implode changes the stage target
twin: Durations and staggers are zero, so every slab moves to its target in one frame
browserCheck: Run explore and implode; sample document animations and frame delta

trigger: Turn commands or drag change the camera azimuth
twin: The turn duration is zero and the camera reaches the target immediately
browserCheck: Turn the camera; sample document animations and frame delta

trigger: Zoom in, zoom out or reset changes the rig zoom
twin: Zoom is applied immediately by the layout effect
browserCheck: Run each zoom command; sample document animations and frame delta

trigger: Pointer highlight, layer focus or dim state changes
twin: Hover, settle and dim durations are zero and the lift distance is zero
browserCheck: Focus and hover components; sample document animations and tween state

trigger: A tour step starts or a tour beat advances
twin: The pulse is zero and tour auto-advance is off
browserCheck: Start and step the tour; sample document animations and advance state

trigger: The tour flow or step changes
twin: The caption animation is skipped when its duration is zero
browserCheck: Advance the tour; sample document animations after the caption update

twin: The trace is drawn at its static endpoint without a travelling dot
browserCheck: Open and advance overlay traces; sample document animations and frame delta

trigger: The overlay becomes visible or a highlighted label changes
twin: The fade duration and CSS transition are both zero
browserCheck: Show the overlay and change labels; sample document animations

trigger: A component or case-study panel opens, changes or closes
twin: panelMotion returns null, placing the panel without an animation
browserCheck: Open, replace and close panels; sample document animations

trigger: The settled lettering surface becomes visible or its offset changes
twin: The fade duration and CSS transition are both zero
browserCheck: Reveal lettering and scroll its column; sample document animations

trigger: Any Tailwind utility using the default transition runs
twin: The default transition duration is zero through the reduced-motion CSS variables
browserCheck: Trigger a default transition; sample document animations

trigger: A navigator proxy receives focus and reveals its component
twin: The focus ring and reveal scroll are instant by construction
browserCheck: Tab through the navigator; sample document animations and frame delta
